notes.decision: Three substances of the maternal cosmic gathering: oil, sweetness/fatness, and beauty of milk. ⲕⲛⲓⲉ = Sah. ⲕⲛⲛⲉ 'fatness, sweetness.' These are the nourishing substances by which the Mother-figure draws the captive light back into herself.

Standard Manichaean cosmological pair Call/Answer (Ruf/Antwort) per accumulated vocabulary. The whole sequence here identifies the enthumesis = counsel of life = Call+Answer addressed to the elements.
Standard Lycopolitan idiom 'stand fast on his feet' (vocab: ⲧⲏⲕ ⲁⲣⲉⲧ⸗). Here 3sg.m subject — the eschatological standing of the Awakened.

Greek σταυρόω 'crucify' applied cosmologically: the Light is crucified/affixed in the Darkness. This is the Manichaean Cross of Light / Jesus patibilis motif — light suspended/suffering in matter. Preserving 'crucified' rather than weakening to 'fixed' or 'set up' retains the theological weight.

Greek ἀναίρεσις 'taking-away, removal, lifting-up.' Translated 'extraction' to capture the eschatological drawing-up of light from the mixture. The verb ⲛⲁⲉⲓ ⲁϩⲣⲏⲓ̈ 'shall come up' confirms the upward-extraction sense.
ⲙⲗⲁϩ 'strife/quarrel' (vocab) — paired here with ⲡⲡⲟⲗⲉⲙⲟⲥ 'war' as the cosmic conflict initiated by the First Man's descent.
ⲕⲉ- 'other' + ⲟⲁⲙ = ϭⲟⲙ 'power.' 'His other powers' = the supplementary forces accompanying the Gate of the Darkness.

Obscure compound. Parallel structure ⲣ ϩⲛ̄ⲭⲙⲛⲣⲱⲙⲉ ⲙ̄ⲛ ϩⲛ[ⲣⲉⲛⲉⲁ] 'made some X-men and some [generations]' suggests ⲭⲙⲛ = a generative/establishing root paralleling γενεά. Tentatively rendered 'generations of men.' Could be ϫⲡⲟ-/ⲥⲙⲛ-/ⲭⲙⲛ- root for begetting or establishing. Flag for review.

Chapter title 'Three Times' — the foundational Manichaean eschatological schema (Initial Time / Mixed Time / Final Time). The three καιροί are enumerated below: light's descent and crucifixion in darkness (Time 1) → mixed warfare while sons remain in worlds (Time 2) → final extraction (Time 3).
